profile.subtitleJa: エリメレクとナオミの子
profile.summaryJa: ルツ記1章2節は、エリメレクとナオミの二人の息子の一人としてキルヨンを挙げます。ベツレヘムのエフラタ人の家族はモアブへ移りました。

facts.textJa: キルヨンとマフロンはともに死んだと記されます。
ボアズは、ナオミからエリメレク、キルヨン、マフロンに属したものを買い取ったと証言します。

wikipedia.noteJa: この記事はルツ記のマフロンとキルヨンを兄弟として扱います。キルヨンについて本文にない説明は加えません。

sources.title: Mahlon and Chilion
sources.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, “Mahlon and Chilion”, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chilion; CC BY-SA 4.0.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi. The names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehem Judah. They came into the country of Moab and lived there.
Mahlon and Chilion both died, and the woman was bereaved of her two children and of her husband.
Boaz said to the elders and to all the people, “You are witnesses today, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, from the hand of Naomi.
